thread:
emily: Hi finance 🙏 — quick question from my trip to Berlin. Corporate card posted two lines for a rental: AUTOHIRE 198.70 EUR and a separate AIRPORT SURCHARGE 24.00 EUR. The PDF receipt I have is just a one-line total and a short confirmation code. I need an itemized invoice with VAT breakdown for VAT reclaim and to check whether the airport surcharge is reimbursable under policy.

jon: Can you attach the PDF and the card statement screenshot to the expense? We'll need the reservation number and whether any extras were accepted at pickup (GPS, insurance, child seat, fuel prepay). Also confirm if the surcharge was explained by the agent as a mandatory airport/terminal fee or an optional convenience charge.

emily: Files uploaded to expense EXP-2025-211. Reservation: AH-772233. Card txn id: AUTOHIRE*AH772233 / stmt ref 3312-998. I declined extra insurance and extras. Agent said something like "terminal access surcharge" when I picked the car up, but it was verbal, no folio provided.

sarah: For VAT reclaim we need a VAT invoice showing supplier tax id and VAT line items. For reimbursement: mandatory government/airport fees are usually reimbursable, vendor convenience fees are not unless pre-approved. Ask AutoHire for a folio titled "Invoice / Rental folio" that breaks out base rental, VAT, tolls, and "airport surcharge" line with tax id. If they won't provide it we'll open a vendor request and potentially a dispute for the surcharge line.

emily: Drafting email now: ```Subject: EXP-2025-211 - Request for VAT invoice for AH-772233
Hello AutoHire accounts team,
Could you please issue a VAT-compliant invoice or folio for reservation AH-772233 that shows a breakdown of base rental, VAT amounts, and the airport surcharge. The charge posted to our corporate card on 2025-07-02 (txn id AUTOHIRE*AH772233). We need the supplier VAT number to support reclaim. Please include EXP-2025-211 in the subject.
Thanks,
Emily (Redwood Inference)``` Is that sufficient?

jon: Looks good. Add our company VAT number (DE123456789) and cc finance@redwood.ai. If they reply with a single-line receipt, reply back asking explicitly for the supplier VAT number and invoice format for tax purposes.

emily: Sent. Auto-reply: "Thanks for contacting AutoHire, we'll respond within 5 business days." Great.

expensebot: Expense EXP-2025-211 moved to vendor-requested. Reminder set for 6 business days.

sarah: I'll flag the payments team to be ready if you want to dispute the surcharge after 7 business days. Emily, please add a short note in the expense about the verbal explanation the agent gave at pickup (copy what they said). That helps us judge reimbursability.

emily: Note added: "Agent said 'airport terminal access fee' charged at pickup; no paper folio provided." Also manager gave verbal pre-approval for necessary fees for the trip.

jon: One more thing — if the vendor provides an invoice but doesn't show VAT separately (some EU vendors do this wrong), finance may accept it for reimbursement but we can't reclaim VAT. We'll update you after vendor response.

emily: Thanks team :thumbsup: Will follow up if no invoice in 5bd.
